desc:
The garden centre has been left to run wild and it's all yours to put right.

Shelve every last item and bring the centre back to life!

Enjoying the game? Give it a like!👍

Found a bug? Report it in the group.

How to play
🌱 Shelve every item in the store before the clock runs out
🧹 Buy tools and upgrades to work faster
🌸 Earn Blooms to unlock trails, auras and more
👥 Play solo, or team up in parties of up to 6

🖥️ PC Controls
E or Click: Pick up / place item
F: Drop item
Scroll: Cycle held item
1 / 2 / 3 / 4: Scanner, Magnet, Goggles, Wand
Q: Shop
TAB: Upgrades
X: Settings
V: Free mouse

🎮 Console Controls
R2: Pick up / place item
L2: Drop item
L1 / R1: Cycle held item
DPad Up / Right / Down / Left: Scanner, Magnet, Goggles, Wand
Square / X: Shop
Triangle / Y: Upgrades
Circle / B: Settings
Share / View: Show screen buttons
